{
  "name": "blog-site",
  "type": "module",
  "version": "0.0.1",
  "allowScripts": {
    "esbuild": true,
    "fsevents": false
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.12.0"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "astro dev",
    "generate:og": "node scripts/generate-og-images.mjs",
    "build": "npm run generate:og && astro build",
    "verify:guides": "node --test scripts/verify-buying-guides.test.mjs",
    "fonts:subset": "node scripts/fonts/subset/run.mjs",
    "preview": "astro preview",
    "astro": "astro"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@astrojs/rss": "^4.0.18",
    "@astrojs/sitemap": "^3.7.1",
    "astro": "^7.3.3",
    "gray-matter": "^4.0.3",
    "http-cache-semantics": "file:../vendor/http-cache-semantics",
    "satori": "^0.33.5",
    "sharp": "^0.35.5"
  },
  "overrides": {
    "http-cache-semantics": "$http-cache-semantics",
    "sharp": "$sharp",
    "devalue": "^5.9.4",
    "defu": "^6.1.5",
    "esbuild": "0.28.1",
    "fast-xml-parser": "^5.8.0",
    "h3": "^1.15.9",
    "picomatch": "^4.0.4",
    "postcss": "^8.5.18",
    "smol-toml": "^1.7.1",
    "fflate": "0.7.5"
  }
}
